product_flow.name: Motion picture film, exposed and developed, whether or not incorporating sound track or consisting only of sound track

required_qualifiers: 5222 emulsion and roll identity
grey acetate base and retained full layer structure
35mm DXN718 BH-1866 and measured actual length
moving-image negative without soundtrack
actual exposure and dark handling sites and dates
bulk D-96/D-96R and F-5 preparation with exact supply forms
each whole chemical assay and actual batch control
stop-rinse diversion and countercurrent topology
actual dryer energy humidity and outlet state
quality criteria densitometry fixing washing and defect records
net first-release mass Q and independent length or area bridge
raw WIP nonWIP and FG histories with per-flow inherited burdens
each silver species phase and real liquid solid gas destination
all supplier receiver and packaging coverage
native supply route grade geography medium property and unit
site period allocation uncertainty and service Qc/H

product_flow.name: 已曝光和冲洗的电影胶片，不论是否包含音轨或仅由音轨组成

required_qualifiers: 5222乳剂及卷标识
灰色醋酸酯片基及保留完整层结构
35毫米DXN718 BH-1866及实测实际片长
无声轨电影摄影负片
实际曝光及暗处理地点和日期
散装原料D-96/D-96R及F-5混配和精确供货形态
各整份化学品含量及真实批次控制
停显洗水分流与逆流拓扑
实际干燥能源湿度及出口状态
质量标准及密度测定定影水洗缺陷记录
净首放行质量Q与独立片长或面积桥接
原片在制非在制及成品历史和逐流继承负荷
各银物种相态与真实气液固去向
全部供方接收方及包装覆盖
原生供货路线等级地域介质属性及单位
场址期间分配不确定性及服务Qc/H
